name: bullet-chart
title: Bullet chart
description: A React bullet chart, Stephen Few's compact gauge: actual as a bar, target as a marker and ranges behind, with deltas that never rely on color. MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Bullet chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/bullet-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { BulletChart, BulletTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/bullet-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
